regions.introTitleHtml: Payabbhi® — Own Your Payments. Build Your Merchant Payments Business.
regions.introHtml:
Payabbhi® is a cloud-native, API-first merchant payments platform that brings payment acceptance, merchant operations, partner management, transaction processing, and revenue control together on one extensible platform.

Built for PSPs, PayFacs, banks, ISOs, ISVs, and merchant-serving ecosystems, it helps organizations move beyond fragmented payment tooling to build, operate, and scale branded payment propositions with greater control over merchant relationships, payment experiences, and economics.

metrics.descHtml: 70% demonstrated reduction in merchant onboarding time
With transaction processing in under 20 seconds

regions.whyTitleHtml: One platform for the full merchant payment lifecycle
regions.whyHtml:
Payabbhi® brings onboarding, acceptance, processing, settlement, reconciliation, partner management, and revenue control into one platform. API-first capabilities help accelerate merchant onboarding, while built-in analytics and operational tools improve visibility.

Flexible pricing, partner and revenue-share models give you greater control over payment economics, while white-label capabilities help create differentiated payment experiences under your brand.

caps.descHtml: Accept payments across POS, e-commerce, mobile commerce, apps, hosted payment pages, payment links, and QR-based journeys.
Manage merchant onboarding, underwriting, configuration, activation, and ongoing merchant operations from a unified platform.
Support ISOs, ISVs, PayFacs, and multi-entity ecosystems with structured partner relationships, permissions, and downstream control.
Orchestrate payment processing across acceptance channels with transaction visibility, business rules, authentication, tokenization and operational controls.
Bring settlement, clearing, reconciliation and transaction visibility together to reduce fragmented operations and improve financial control.
Support secure payment experiences with tokenized data handling, fraud management, configurable controls, and auditability.
REST APIs, developer portal, sandbox capabilities, documentation, and modular services help teams integrate and extend payment experiences.
Manage merchant pricing, fees, funding, partner structures, and revenue-share models with greater visibility into payment economics.

regions.introTitleHtml: Payabbhi® — Modernising Merchant Acquiring for India
regions.introHtml:
India’s payment ecosystem is evolving rapidly, with high-volume digital acceptance and increasingly sophisticated models across banks, PSPs, PayFacs, and ISVs.

Payabbhi® brings merchant onboarding, KYC, underwriting, fraud management, payment acceptance, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation, and analytics onto a unified platform, helping organizations simplify payment operations and gain greater control over merchants, data, and the payment lifecycle.

metrics.descHtml: 70% demonstrated reduction in merchant onboarding time
With transaction processing in under 20 seconds

regions.whyTitleHtml: Built for India’s evolving merchant payments ecosystem.
regions.whyHtml:
Payabbhi® combines API-first architecture with the capabilities needed to onboard, operate, and manage merchants at scale. For PSPs, acquiring banks and payment-led businesses, API-based onboarding and KYC automation help simplify merchant activation, while integrated support for underwriting, processor connectivity, equipment management and payment operations keeps the merchant lifecycle connected.

Payment, settlement, payout and transaction data come together to provide clearer reconciliation and operational visibility, while configurable fraud controls, including velocity checks, rules, alerts and analytics, help organizations manage payment risk with greater precision.

caps.descHtml: Digitise merchant onboarding with API-first workflows, documentation, role-based controls and configurable account setup.
Support risk-based merchant onboarding and account configuration as part of the acquiring operating model.
Apply velocity checks, configurable rules, alerts and analytics to strengthen payment-risk management.
Track payment events across authorization, capture, refund, and other transaction stages with unified operational visibility.
Support clearing, settlement, payout, and reconciliation workflows while maintaining visibility across payment and merchant data.
Provide dashboards, transaction analytics, audit trails, and reporting to help payment teams understand merchant performance.
Use tokenized payment data and wallet capabilities to support stored-payment and recurring-payment experiences.

regions.introTitleHtml: Payabbhi® — Modern Merchant Payments for Canada’s Evolving Payment Landscape
regions.introHtml:
Canada’s payment infrastructure is evolving toward richer, more structured messaging, with ISO 20022 underpinning modern systems such as the Real-Time Rail (RTR) and enabling greater interoperability and transparency. Payabbhi® complements this evolution with an API-first merchant payments platform that connects acceptance, onboarding, partner management, fraud controls, tokenization, settlement, reconciliation, and analytics.

For PSPs, PayFacs, ISVs and merchant-serving organizations, this creates a more connected alternative to fragmented payment operations, helping them build differentiated payment experiences while maintaining visibility and control across merchants, partners and transactions.

metrics.descHtml: 70% demonstrated reduction in merchant onboarding time
With transaction processing in under 20 seconds

regions.whyTitleHtml: Turn richer payment data into better merchant operations.
regions.whyHtml:
As Canada’s payment environment becomes more connected and data-rich, Payabbhi® provides an API-first, ISO 20022-ready approach that helps payment providers make better use of payment and remittance data for processing and reconciliation.

By bringing acceptance, merchant and partner management, settlement and analytics together, it reduces reliance on fragmented payment stacks, while hierarchical permissions and unified settlement and reconciliation workflows provide greater visibility and control across PSPs, ISOs, ISVs, merchants and payment partners.

caps.descHtml: Support POS, e-commerce, mobile commerce, in-app journeys, hosted pages and payment links through one acceptance platform.
Use modular APIs and integration-ready services to build payment experiences around evolving Canadian payment requirements.
Support secure payment-data handling with tokenization and enterprise-grade security controls.
Manage merchant activation, underwriting, configuration and ongoing merchant lifecycle operations.
Give payment providers visibility and control across partners, merchants and multi-entity operating structures.
Support configurable fraud rules, alerts, velocity checks and payment-risk controls within the merchant operating layer.
Automate and monitor settlement, reconciliation and funding workflows across merchant and partner relationships.
Combine reporting, transaction analytics, pricing, fees and revenue-share capabilities to improve visibility into merchant economics.

regions.introTitleHtml: Payabbhi® — Build a Smarter Merchant Payments Business in the U.S.
regions.introHtml:
The U.S. merchant payments landscape demands flexible acceptance, secure checkout and seamless integration across PSPs, PayFacs, acquirers and ISVs. Payabbhi® provides a modular, API-first platform for cards, ACH, e-commerce, POS, embedded and recurring payments, bringing merchant operations, fraud management, reconciliation and settlement together in one operating layer.

Its U.S. relevance is demonstrated through government-focused utility and eCheck payment implementations, including split funding for bill amounts and convenience fees.

metrics.descHtml: 70% demonstrated reduction in merchant boarding time
With transaction processing in under 20 seconds
$37M monthly transaction value in an acquiring-bank implementation

regions.whyTitleHtml: Compete with speed, control and payment intelligence.
regions.whyHtml:
For U.S. PSPs, ISOs and PayFacs, differentiation goes beyond the transaction itself. Payabbhi® combines API-first integration with REST APIs, Swagger and sandbox capabilities, helping ISVs, PSPs and PayFacs connect faster without legacy complexity.

Once connected, tokenization, fraud controls, velocity checks, configurable rules and alerts strengthen payment security, while card and ACH support brings settlement, reconciliation and reporting into the same flow. Flexible merchant pricing, fees, partner structures, funding and split-funding models then give providers greater control over their commercial operations.

caps.descHtml: Support card and ACH payment journeys across physical and digital merchant environments.
Provide branded payment collection through hosted pages, payment links and other low-friction acceptance experiences.
Embed payment capabilities directly into software, applications and merchant journeys.
Protect sensitive payment data through tokenized payment handling and secure payment experiences.
Apply velocity checks, configurable rules, alerts and fraud controls to identify and manage suspicious payment activity.
Manage merchants, ISOs, partners and downstream entities with role-based access and hierarchical controls.
Support automated settlement, multi-layer reconciliation, transaction closing, and financial visibility across payment operations.
Support flexible commercial models, including fee management and split funding for use cases where transaction components must be routed to different downstream accounts.

regions.introTitleHtml: Payabbhi® — Merchant Payments Built for a Connected Nordic Market.
regions.introHtml:
The Nordic payment environment continues to evolve around instant credit transfers, interoperability, digital-first experiences, and increasingly structured payment data.

Payabbhi® brings a modern operating layer to this connected environment, combining payment acceptance with merchant and partner management, fraud controls, reconciliation, and analytics for PSPs, ISVs, PayFacs, and merchant-serving ecosystems.

metrics.descHtml: 70% demonstrated reduction in merchant onboarding time
With transaction processing in under 20 seconds

regions.whyTitleHtml: Speed for merchants and control for payment ecosystems.
regions.whyHtml:
In a digitally mature Nordic market, Payabbhi® helps payment providers connect modern merchant journeys with evolving payment infrastructure through its API-first, modular architecture.

It brings merchant and partner management into a connected operating environment, with support for ISOs, aggregators, and multi-entity relationships, while reconciliation, settlement visibility, dashboards, and reporting provide a clearer view of transactions, fraud, and commercial performance. Cloud-enabled, microservices-based architecture adds the flexibility and resilience needed to launch faster and evolve with the payment ecosystem.

caps.descHtml: Support web, mobile, app, POS, hosted pages, payment links and other digital-first merchant journeys.
Manage aggregators, ISOs, ISVs and merchants through structured relationships and role-based access.
Use modular APIs, developer tools and sandbox capabilities to reduce integration friction and support faster implementation.
Apply configurable fraud rules, velocity checks, alerts and security controls across merchant payment operations.
Maintain a unified view of payment events, merchant activity and operational data across acceptance channels.
Bring reconciliation, settlement and funding visibility together to simplify multi-entity payment operations.
Give merchant-serving teams actionable reporting and portfolio-level visibility across transactions, partners and payment performance.
Support flexible pricing, fees, partner structures and revenue-share models across merchant and partner ecosystems.
